carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the lower lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transitioning from light pixels on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated linear object is visible trailing from the posterior base of the first dorsal fin, consistent with a parasitic attachment or external tagging device.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique structural anomaly is present in the vertical stripe patterning at the mid-flank (indicated by a white arrow), where a pale band forms a distinct U-shaped loop rather than a continuous vertical line.
